keywords=['internet','wifi','wlan','broadband','xfinity','comcast','verizon','att','isp','router','cable']
selected=[]
for t in all_tx:
    desc=(t.get('description') or '').lower()
    recv=(t.get('receiver',{}).get('name') or '').lower()
    if any(k in desc or k in recv for k in keywords):
        selected.append(t)
selected_ids=sorted([t['transaction_id'] for t in selected])
selected_amounts=[t['amount'] for t in selected]
selected_sum=sum(selected_amounts)
print('selected_count',len(selected))
print('selected_ids',selected_ids)
print('selected_amounts',selected_amounts)
